summary: Playtest passed: the beacon pilgrimage controller completed beacon_1 -> beacon_2 -> beacon_3 and emitted quest_completed, while baseline exploration still shows healthy roam/target control behavior.
observations: Connectivity confirmed ([OPEN] connected, [OBS] first observation received).
Mission progression observed in-order: objective_completed beacon_1, beacon_2, beacon_3, then quest_completed.
Stable ACT stream during quest run with objective/objective_hint targeting and decreasing distance to active beacons.
Baseline regression check with default controller (RUN_SEC=30) showed both mode=roam and mode=target with continuous actions.
Screenshots/captures were non-blank and show world/player context with plausible movement over time.
issues: Initial 180s handoff-command attempt showed prolonged no-progress behavior (distance to beacon_1 stayed fixed) and was aborted; issue did not reproduce in subsequent validation run.
nextRecommendations: Investigate intermittent startup no-progress condition in playtest controller/bootstrap (focus/keepalive or objective-init race).
Keep one quick default-controller smoke run in future cycles to preserve explicit roam/target regression coverage.
Optionally add explicit playtest log line for movement delta per interval to detect stalls earlier.
